messages.author: 30cd1a90c87f65db
messages.subject: Native BLAS/LAPACK
parts:
Hi,

I understand that netlib-java allows us to use a platform optimised version of BLAS/LAPACK, for example vecLib on Mac OS X.  I've been trying to see if that's possible with renjin, but have failed so far.  I see that renjin has a modified version of netlib-java which fails to load the native versions of BLAS/LAPACK.

With the original netlib-java 1.1.1 I am able to use vecLib. So, is it possible to use vecLib with rejin?

Thanks,
Ahmed.

messages.author: f06db63329fab1f9
messages.subject: Re: Native BLAS/LAPACK
parts:
Hi Ahmed,
That's certainly the goal -- you should be able to use vecLib with renjin just as you would with netlib-java. The patched version we use of netlib-java address only a minor issue with netlib-java on Google AppEngine, but it's possible that the patch built did not properly include the jni scaffolding for the Mac -- can you file a bug report at http://github.com/bedatadriven/renjin/issues and I will see if we can fix it or if our patch has been included in the latest release of netlib-java

In the meantime, you should be able to replace the Renjin's patched version of netlib-java with the latest release of netlib java if you're not running on AppEngine.

Best,
Alex

messages.author: 30cd1a90c87f65db
messages.subject: Re: Native BLAS/LAPACK
parts:
Hello Alex,

Many thanks for the quick reply.  I've looked into replacing the patched netlib with the current netlib release 1.1.1.  I couldn't just do a drop in replacement of the jars, but had to modify a few renjin source files and recompile renjin. This is mainly because the netlib package name has changed.  Here are the changes I had to make to renjin

modify the ./core/pom.xml and ./appl/pom.xml and replace the netlib dependency with:

<dependency>
  <groupId>com.github.fommil.netlib</groupId>
  <artifactId>all</artifactId>
  <version>1.1.1</version>
  <type>pom</type>
</dependency>

Then I had to fix the package imports on the following Java source files:
core/src/main/java/org/renjin/primitives/matrix/MatrixProduct.java
core/src/main/java/org/renjin/base/Lapack.java
appl/src/main/java/org/renjin/appl/ExternalRoutines.java

The new imports are (instead of org.netlib.blas.BLAS):
import com.github.fommil.netlib.BLAS
import com.github.fommil.netlib.LAPACK

After that, I rebuilt renjin on a Linux box, and now I am able to use vecLib on Mac OS X :-)  I will file an issue, so you could track it.  Many thanks for renjin, which is absolutely fantastic.

Thanks,
Ahmed.

messages.author: 30cd1a90c87f65db
messages.subject: Re: Native BLAS/LAPACK
parts:
Oh, forgot to mention the speedup after switching to vecLib.  I tested the following R benchmark

2800x2800 cross-product matrix (b = a' * a)_________ (sec):  0.86766666666667 

Without vecLib:

2800x2800 cross-product matrix (b = a' * a)_________ (sec):  10.915 

Quite a nice speedup :-)
